title: lupinus arcticus subsp. subalpinus
intro: Lupinus arcticus subsp. subalpinus, commonly known as Arctic lupine, is a subspecies of the lupine plant family (Fabaceae) native to the western United States and Canada. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to support cardiovascular health and improve blood lipid profiles due to its high content of isoflavones and other bioactive compounds. The therapeutic actions of Arctic lupine include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Arctic lupine include isoflavones, alkaloids, and other compounds that have been shown to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
